policy.thresholds: canonical V2 attainable thresholds only; V15 original optional extra 3p on 4p sets not adopted
policy.cooldown: per owner and effect identity, same family across item versions
policy.charges: one-use no stacking or refresh until next eligible activation
policy.shield: candidate strongest same-effect shield replaces only if larger; no stacking across same effect; no claim of global shield policy
policy.setSource: 34 V7 proposals preserved verbatim; 61 new numerical designs not approved
